description: Builds an unsigned exactInputSingle swap on Uniswap v3 and returns an approval URL. Automatically picks the best fee tier if not specified, applies slippage protection, and instructs the user to also approve the ERC-20 if needed. The user reviews and approves in the Privy wallet UI; poll the request with `poll_request` to get the tx hash.

amount_in.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "1.5". Use a string to preserve precision.

fee.description: Uniswap v3 fee tier. If omitted, the best tier from a quote sweep is used.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points (1bps = 0.01%). Default 50 = 0.5%.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the approval link stays valid. Defaults to 5 minutes.

name: uniswap_swap
title: Swap tokens on Uniswap v3 (Monad)
